summary: Codere Online Luxembourg, S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited third-quarter 2026 results via press release and presentation. Revenue was EUR 62.6mm (+31% YoY), with Spain EUR 24.8mm (+13%) and Mexico EUR 32.9mm (+37%); Gaming Win reached EUR 67.1mm (+30%) and Adjusted EBITDA EUR 4.2mm (+45%). Net income was EUR 11.1mm for 9M 2026 versus a EUR 1.7mm loss a year earlier. Cash totaled EUR 65.6mm with no financial debt at September 30, 2026; management reiterated FY2026 Gaming Win guidance of EUR 255-265mm and Adjusted EBITDA of EUR 20-25mm. No transaction, ownership change, or board recommendation is disclosed; this is a routine earnings filing, not a special situation.
